nodes.label: Contributor graph-first onboarding
nodes.rationale: Read map coverage, relevant communities, symbol neighbors, authoritative source and tests before changes; refresh stale maps without blocking an unrelated small fix.

nodes.label: MISO desktop calendar companion
nodes.rationale: Windows desktop cat for Google Calendar accounts, tasks, reminders and important dates. AI is optional and disabled by default.

nodes.label: Serialized incremental calendar synchronization
nodes.rationale: Background polls consume incremental feeds; completed writes and manual refresh rebuild expanded windows. Account reads have a limit of two, and failed accounts preserve cached reminders.

nodes.label: Deadline based reminder scheduling
nodes.rationale: Next-deadline scheduling replaces idle one-second polling; minute checks handle clock changes, quiet hours and catch-up. Snoozes have separate deadlines.

nodes.label: OS encrypted local vault
nodes.rationale: Protect all local settings, accounts, events and secrets with Electron safeStorage; fail startup rather than overwrite an unreadable vault. OS user compromise is outside this boundary.

nodes.label: Google Desktop OAuth public-client configuration
nodes.rationale: Bundled desktop app identity enables setup without a Cloud project. Desktop client configuration is extractable and must stay distinct from private account tokens and AI keys.

nodes.label: Optional AI commands
nodes.rationale: Calendar features do not require AI. Enabled commands and clarification context go to the chosen provider or local endpoint.

nodes.label: Sandboxed renderer and trusted IPC boundary
nodes.rationale: Keep secrets in main, require trusted main-frame IPC, deny navigation/new windows/webviews/permissions and renderer network access.
nodes.norm_label: sandboxed renderer and trusted ipc boundary

nodes.label: Isolated synthetic-account verification
nodes.rationale: Offline and Electron workflow tests avoid personal calendar data and credentials. Live consent, DST and device integration still require manual checks.

nodes.label: Generated artwork manifest
nodes.rationale: Select supplied artwork by exact base name with WebP, PNG, GIF, SVG priority. Preserve original art and use original cat fallback for absent or failed poses.

nodes.label: Renderer HTML and content security policy
nodes.norm_label: renderer html and content security policy

nodes.label: Windows AppUserModelID alignment
nodes.rationale: Use dev.butler.desktop consistently for Electron, Windows windows and installed shortcuts so the shell groups the MISO icon correctly. Packaged relaunch icons point to the real executable because Windows Shell cannot resolve icons inside app.asar.

nodes.label: Embedded PE metadata and icon auditing
nodes.rationale: Read actual executable ProductName, FileDescription and icon payloads to establish packaged Windows branding beyond configuration assertions.
nodes.norm_label: embedded pe metadata and icon auditing

nodes.label: Stable MISO and Butler installation identity
nodes.rationale: Keep appId dev.butler.desktop and NSIS GUID d42cf777-6b55-53ad-8b39-da340cc05379 stable across releases.
nodes.norm_label: stable miso and butler installation identity

nodes.label: Existing machine-wide scope and elevation
nodes.rationale: Read registered HKLM location and uninstall command; force machine scope for assisted install mode and initialize elevation explicitly for silent mode.

nodes.label: Stop setup if previous uninstall fails
nodes.rationale: Launch errors and nonzero uninstall results stop setup with exit code 2; both standard and current-user checks use the same policy.
nodes.norm_label: stop setup if previous uninstall fails

nodes.label: Preserved accounts and settings across reinstalls
nodes.rationale: deleteAppDataOnUninstall remains false; reinstall fixtures require KEEP_APP_DATA and verify a saved profile marker remains.
nodes.norm_label: preserved accounts and settings across reinstalls

nodes.label: Eleven compiled installer upgrade scenarios
nodes.rationale: Nine scope/removal policy cases plus actual stock NSIS uninstallOldVersion same-directory and changed-directory replacement. Synthetic registry namespace, temporary files, and profile preservation markers avoid production registrations.

nodes.label: Slide-based first-run onboarding
nodes.rationale: Welcome, required Google sign-in, optional AI choice and verified draft configuration, explicit retryable sync on both branches, then Start MISO. Completion persists encrypted; manual calendar features work without AI.

nodes.label: Protected onboarding completion and migration
nodes.rationale: New profiles remain incomplete until Start MISO; old profiles with accounts migrate as complete only when no explicit completion flag exists. The encrypted vault persists the flag and reset restores defaults.

nodes.label: Optional unelevated Launch MISO checkbox
nodes.rationale: Custom finish pages require explicit MUI run definitions. Mirror the stock assisted callback using StdUtils.ExecShellAsUser on the installed shortcut, with --updated only during updates, for asynchronous Windows-user launch. Expanding StartApp here would redeclare its global variable.

nodes.label: Separate recovery profile
nodes.rationale: Open an empty separate profile while preserving the original unreadable encrypted vault.

nodes.label: Branded NSIS wizard resources
nodes.rationale: Commit 24-bit wizard bitmaps using the existing mascot and bundled fonts for portable packaging.

nodes.label: Replace registered installations before copying files
nodes.norm_label: replace registered installations before copying files

nodes.label: Paginated text-model discovery and ranking
nodes.rationale: Fetch provider catalogs with bounded pagination, filter unsupported generation models, and rank stable efficient candidates dynamically without returning keys.

nodes.label: Verified draft AI configuration
nodes.rationale: Automatic verifies up to three discovered candidates using a synthetic reminder parse; explicit model tests one candidate. Commit configuration, encrypted key and fingerprint only after success; preserve working settings on failure.

nodes.label: Sanitized AI access and quota errors
nodes.rationale: Interpret known reason codes without exposing remote messages, requests or keys. Gemini key restrictions, access, unavailable model, network and exhausted quota remain distinct.
nodes.norm_label: sanitized ai access and quota errors

nodes.label: Persisted AI-assisted and User-assisted workflows
nodes.rationale: AI-assisted uses natural-language scheduling when AI is enabled and verified; User-assisted uses manual steps without AI requests. Mode persists independently of AI enablement.

nodes.label: AI-created event receipt and confirmed manual edits
nodes.rationale: Clear high-confidence create commands save directly to Google and return the saved event for review. Ambiguity asks clarification. Receipt editing uses the manual preview/confirm flow; existing-event edits and deletions retain confirmation.
nodes.norm_label: ai-created event receipt and confirmed manual edits

nodes.label: Explicit onboarding sync completion gate
nodes.rationale: Both AI Yes and No require explicit successful sync after the choice. Preliminary/background refresh cannot unlock Start MISO. Configure/AI-enabled choice invalidates the marker; pending/failed sync remains blocked.
